slide1_company_intro.value: Clean Science and Technology Limited (NSE: CLEAN | BSE: 543318), headquartered in Pune, is a global specialty chemical manufacturer pioneering clean, catalytic vapor-phase manufacturing processes. It is the world's #1 producer of MEHQ, BHA, Anisole, and 4-MAP, and India's first commercial manufacturer of Hindered Amine Light Stabilizers (HALS).
slide1_company_intro.source: Clean Science and Technology Limited FY25 Annual Report

slide1_brand_portfolio.value: Three core verticals: Performance Chemicals (MEHQ, BHA, Ascorbyl Palmitate, HALS 701/770/622/944), Pharma & Agro Intermediates (Guaiacol, DCC, p-Benzoquinone), and FMCG Chemicals (4-MAP, Anisole).
slide1_brand_portfolio.source: Clean Science and Technology Limited FY25 Annual Report

slide1_business_model.value: Proprietary atom-efficient catalytic processes rooted in backward integration from basic phenol/methanol feedstocks into high-purity specialty stabilizers, generating structural 40%+ EBITDA margins with zero commercial debt.
slide1_business_model.source: Clean Science and Technology Limited FY25 Annual Report

slide1_product_ecosystem.value: Three established manufacturing units at Kurkumbh MIDC (29,900 MTPA) plus the newly commissioned 34-acre Unit 4 under wholly-owned subsidiary Clean Fino-Chem Limited (CFCL, 10,500 MTPA expanding to 15,000 MTPA).
slide1_product_ecosystem.source: Clean Science and Technology Limited FY25 Annual Report

slide1_strategic_approach.value: Scaling commercial utilization of CFCL Unit 4 HALS series from 35% in FY24 and 55% in FY25 to 90% by FY30E alongside new performance intermediates, self-funded entirely through internal operating cash flows.
slide1_strategic_approach.source: Clean Science and Technology Limited FY25 Annual Report

slide2_company_name.source: Clean Science and Technology Limited FY25 Annual Report

slide2_executive_summary.value: In FY25, Clean Science delivered Consolidated Revenue from Operations of ₹967 Cr (+22.3% YoY), Operating Profit (EBITDA) of ₹388 Cr (40.1% margin), and Net Profit (PAT) of ₹264 Cr (+8.2% YoY, EPS ₹24.86). Parent Units 1–3 generated ₹857 Cr while CFCL Unit 4 HALS contributed ₹110 Cr at 55% utilization.

slide2_thesis.value: Separating Parent Kurkumbh Units 1–3 (10%–11% steady growth) from CFCL Unit 4 (capacity expanding from 10,500 to 15,000 MTPA and utilization ramping from 55% in FY25 to 90% by FY30E) drives consolidated revenue to ₹1,711 Cr by FY30E. Discounting 5-year FCFF at a 12.00% CAPM WACC (Rf 7.30%, Beta 0.904, ERP 5.20%, 100% Equity) with 5.00% terminal growth and adding ₹424 Cr net cash yields ₹4,419 Cr Equity Value or ₹415.69/share (vs ₹1,039.00 snapshot CMP).

slide2_key_highlights.value:
• FY25 Consolidated Revenue: ₹967 Cr (+22.3% YoY); EBITDA: ₹388 Cr (40.1% margin); PAT: ₹264 Cr
• Capacity Split: Parent Units 1–3 (29,900 MTPA, ₹857 Cr) + Subsidiary CFCL Unit 4 HALS (10,500 MTPA, ₹110 Cr @ 55% util)
• Connected 5Y Ramp: CFCL Unit 4 expands to 15,000 MTPA @ 90% utilization -> FY30E Consolidated Revenue ₹1,711 Cr
• CAPM WACC Schedule: 100% Equity-funded (Ke = WACC = 12.00%); Terminal Growth = 5.00%
• Implied DCF Equity Value: ₹4,419 Cr (₹415.69 / share vs ₹1,039.00 15-Oct-2025 CMP)

slide14_narrative.value: Clean Science has funded its entire CFCL Unit 4 greenfield expansion through internal cash accruals with zero debt. In FY25, Cash from Operating Activities was ₹214 Cr against Investing outflows of -₹152 Cr (including ~₹145 Cr CapEx) and Dividend outflows of -₹53 Cr.

slide16_company_name.source: Clean Science and Technology Limited FY25 Annual Report

slide16_current_ratio_narrative.value: With zero commercial borrowings (₹2 Cr lease/working capital facility) and ₹1,417 Cr Net Worth in FY25, Clean Science maintains exceptional balance sheet liquidity. Debtor days stood at 77 days and Inventory days at 156 days in FY25.

slide16_quick_ratio_narrative.value: Cash Conversion Cycle was 130 days in FY25 (Debtor Days 77 + Inventory Days 156 - Payable Days 103) as CFCL built initial HALS raw material and finished goods inventory; consolidated ROCE stood at 27.0% and ROE at 18.6%.
